data: Amazon reported total assets of $818,042 million (about $818.0 billion) at the end of its fiscal 2025 on December 31, 2025, while NVIDIA reported total assets of $111,601 million (about $111.6 billion) at the end of its fiscal 2025 on January 26, 2025. Amazon's asset base is therefore roughly 7.3 times larger than NVIDIA's. The two "fiscal 2025" balance sheets are dated nearly eleven months apart, because NVIDIA's fiscal year ends in late January. Amazon's figure also reflects growth from $624,894 million at the end of 2024, and NVIDIA's rose from $65,728 million at the end of its fiscal 2024.
